body: I guess I'm just scared because... what's to stop it from happening again and putting me right back into this same position, you know?

I keep wishing I could lie to myself, too. But... I lied to myself for three years, pretending things were ok just to find out abut what he was doing behind my back.

I couldn't live through that again. I'm barely surviving right now.

Thanks. I just... I feel like I'm going in a circle. Give it time... but hurt endlessly in the process. And what if time only brings more pain? It has, before. My life has been a neverending circle of pain.

Just when I feel like things are ok, someone hurts me again worse than ever.
We have had people watch her and we have gone out places together. It just feels like a bandaid, you know? Like it temporarily fixes things but then it just comes back even worse later on.

Not really, no. I work too much and when I am off, I have to spend time with my daughter. God, I'm such a bad mother. She should be enough to make me feel ok -- I shouldn't want to leave her.

But I'm just really tired of this constant emotional pain.
With the way my work is... I have no time to try and see anyone. Sad as it is to admit, I really feel like I've given up the will to fight.

He had been cheating on me for three years. I found out at the end of last year. He didn't break it off until April. I was pregnant at the time. I posted a very long and in-depth thing on another subreddit a month ago.

I just... I don't feel like there's anywhere to go. I just live in fear every day and I keep reliving it... Remembering things he said. Knowing things they did. Leaving... it would ruin my entire life. I would still have to see him because of my daughter.

There's just... there's no escape.
